Quick update for your records. This morning I reviewed the inbox, archived the old threads, renamed the shared folders so they follow the new naming pattern, updated the meeting notes from Monday and Tuesday, moved the draft files into the archive folder, checked that the calendar invites were sent, confirmed the room booking for Thursday, sent the reminder to the design team about the font files, cleaned up the duplicate contacts, and updated the internal phone list with the two new extensions. I also printed the visitor badges and refilled the stationery order. Everything is done for today. Thanks.

Please translate this paragraph into Arabic: Our company is preparing to launch in several markets across the Gulf region next year. We will invest in pricing research, legal compliance, partnerships and hiring for the regional offices, and we will compare the options for each country before we commit any budget. The strategy will be reviewed every quarter by the leadership team, and the long term plan includes expansion into Europe and a possible acquisition.
